claims: Sydney is the capital of New South Wales.
Sydney is Australia's most populous city.
Sydney was founded in 1788 as a British penal colony.
Sydney's area has Aboriginal history associated with the Eora nation.
Sydney is known to many as "Warrane".
A taxi/rideshare from Sydney's airport to the city centre costs roughly AU$45–$55.
Sydney has a network of trains, buses, ferries, and light rail.
Contactless payment is available on Sydney's transportation.
Sydney Harbour Bridge has Pylon Lookout.
The Blue Mountains are two hours west of Sydney.
Parramatta functions as a secondary city hub in Sydney.
Queen Victoria Building is a shopping location in Sydney's CBD.
